In contrast, response a is presented only as bullet points, jumps abruptly between legal, cultural, and religious topics, repeats information, and includes an internal contradiction about Western religious opposition versus legal permissiveness. coverage_deep.explantion: Both response a and response b are judged to suffer from the same high‑severity flaws: they are surface‑level/shallow and lack mechanisms explaining why Western and Eastern views differ.
